notes:
What's new in 0.1.98:
- Picture frame (In development, off until you turn it on in Settings): your chosen photos, a clock and a household note on a tablet or TV browser on your home Wi-Fi.
- Shared libraries: guest passes last up to 12 hours and can be renewed early, up to 30 days. Guests signed in with an older version sign in once more. The server part of early renewal is already live.
- Live TV: a playlist that points at this computer or your home network needs your confirmation for each address first.
- Safety fixes: Movie Night re-checks room limits and access right before a room, game or film starts.
- Walkie-talkie from anywhere (In development): a full room frees the unused approval at once, and the guest is told the room is full (the server part is already live).
- Not yet checked: none of this has been tried on a real PC, tablet, phone or TV. Automated tests and reviews only.
- Release source commit 5deccc238.
- Published: Oct 21, 2026, 6:52 AM Eastern.
